context.body: Paul recounts the received tradition of bread and cup and says the cup is the new covenant in Jesus’ blood; the meal proclaims his death until he comes.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The same covenant language now appears in an assembly’s repeated practice and remembrance.
observations.label: The covenant cup becomes repeated memory: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Eat · drink · remember · proclaim visible within its covenant claim.

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 11:23–26 as its own jesus remembered covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Meal repeated until he comes inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
